[Neil Armstrong](/wiki/Neil_Armstrong "Neil Armstrong") and [Buzz Aldrin](/wiki/Buzz_Aldrin "Buzz Aldrin") land the first [Apollo Lunar Module](/wiki/Apollo_Lunar_Module "Apollo Lunar Module") on the Moon, 20 July 1969, creating [Tranquility Base](/wiki/Tranquility_Base "Tranquility Base"). [Apollo 11](/wiki/Apollo_11 "Apollo 11") was the first of six [Apollo program](/wiki/Apollo_program "Apollo program") lunar landings.

President Richard Nixon had speechwriter [William Safire](/wiki/William_Safire "William Safire") prepare a condolence speech for delivery in case Armstrong and Aldrin became marooned on the Moon's surface and could not be rescued.[[59]](#cite_note-59)

In 1951, science fiction writer [Arthur C. Clarke](/wiki/Arthur_C._Clarke "Arthur C. Clarke") forecast that a man would reach the Moon by 1978.[[60]](#cite_note-60)

On 16 August 2006, the [Associated Press](/wiki/Associated_Press "Associated Press") reported that NASA is [missing the original](/wiki/Apollo_11_missing_tapes "Apollo 11 missing tapes") [Slow-scan television](/wiki/Slow-scan_television "Slow-scan television") tapes (which were made before the scan conversion for conventional TV) of the Apollo 11 Moon walk. [[46]](#cite_note-48)

Heng is married to Chang Hwee Nee, the chief executive officer of the [National Heritage Board](/wiki/National_Heritage_Board_(Singapore) "National Heritage Board (Singapore)"). They have two children.[[47]](#cite_note-49)[[48]](#cite_note-50)[[49]](#cite_note-51)

On 12 May 2016, Heng collapsed from a [stroke](/wiki/Stroke "Stroke") during a [Cabinet](/wiki/Cabinet_of_Singapore "Cabinet of Singapore") meeting. He was taken to [Tan Tock Seng Hospital](/wiki/Tan_Tock_Seng_Hospital "Tan Tock Seng Hospital"), where he underwent [neurosurgery](/wiki/Neurosurgery "Neurosurgery") to relieve pressure in his brain. He was transferred to the [intensive care unit](/wiki/Intensive_care_unit "Intensive care unit") after the surgery[[50]](#cite_note-52)[[51]](#cite_note-53) and discharged on 25 June 2016. He resumed his duties as a Member of Parliament and Minister for Finance on 22 August 2016.[[52]](#cite_note-54)
